remarks: Beautifully remodeled 2 bedroom Linden House condo on the second floor overlooking Glenbrook Road. Bright kitchen with pantry, granite counters, new cabinets, sink, dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator and tile floor. New full bath with tub/shower. Laundry and dedicated extra large storage area in the basement. One reserved parking spot. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas also included in the rent.
